question: Every distinct connected arrangement of up to five parity knots of three to five places grown by the cubic study's joining rule under the fewest counts: which dimensions occur, how often (distinct and labelled weights, per number of knots), and does the chain-birth rule predict every dimension?

definitions.arrangement: a connected multigraph on knots with sizes 3-5, degree <= size, up to renaming
definitions.birth: an offshoot of demand 1 whose parent is not an offshoot of demand 1
definitions.class: births of one round with one partner (a sibling pair is one class)
definitions.dimension: 0 if closed; k + 1 for the least k with constant nonzero k-th differences of junctions per round over the last seven rounds

public_inputs.reused: FIRST-KNOT-20261118-001B startlib.py and FRESH-COUNT-20261118-001B freelib.py (closed records), imported by path

forbidden_inputs: Changing cases, rules, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: G and P1a-P6 of research/TOUCH-CENSUS-20261118-001/preregistration.md, scored by merge.py.
cheapest_meaningful_control: checks.py: brute-force isomorphism counts to three knots; five known starts.

predictions.P1b: dimension = largest class when there is a birth
predictions.P2: 2 most common among settled growing; >= 3 under 2% distinct and labelled
predictions.P3: none above 4, none unsettled after rerun, exactly one of dimension 4
predictions.P5: stall share rises to > 40% at five knots; dim-2 share rises and dim-1 share falls with knots

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as scored by merge.py

stop_rule: One run; read-out; referee hand-off; report.

amendments.change: After 259 of 265 shards, the last six had run 22 minutes on reruns of unsettled arrangements to 25,000 junctions (one probed arrangement, a ring of five knots with no chain birth, took 303 seconds to reach 7,316 junctions). The run was stopped and resumed with the rerun capped at 12,000 junctions, 40 rounds or 600 seconds (outcome timed). Results of the 259 finished shards are kept; no case, rule, prediction or decision rule changed; P3 scores any arrangement left unsettled. merge.py counts the new outcome "timed" as growing (unsettled unless its dimension was read).
